requirements.title: Dependency Integration and Allowlist Policy
requirements.rationale: Replacing hand-rolled transport and parsing with the official Anthropic SDK eliminates custom protocol maintenance while enforcing dependency allowlist constraints.

criteria.action: require github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go pinned in go.mod
criteria.contract: github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go is listed as a direct dependency with a pinned minor version

setup: the repository root containing go.mod
check.pseudocode: mod = read('go.mod'); assert 'github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go' in mod; assert not 'v0.0.0-' in modVersion('github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go')

criteria.condition: the dependency allowlist test in internal/policy/deps_test.go evaluates direct dependencies from go.mod
criteria.action: approve github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go as an authorized direct dependency
criteria.contract: the allowlist accepts github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go without assertion failure

setup: the policy test suite in internal/policy/deps_test.go
check.pseudocode: allowed = loadAllowedDeps(); assert 'github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go' in allowed; runDepsPolicyTest(t)

criteria.action: use official SDK client primitives from github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go for HTTP transport and stream decoding, eliminating custom SSE parsing and ad-hoc credential refresh routines
criteria.contract: requests and stream decoding are dispatched using anthropic.Client primitives; custom SSE parsing and ad-hoc credential refresh logic are not invoked

setup: an Anthropic provider constructed via official SDK options
check.pseudocode: client := anthropic.NewClient(option.WithAPIKey("key")); p := anthropicprovider.NewWithClient(client); assert p.UsesSDKClient()

requirements.title: Multi-Deployment Environment Resolution
requirements.rationale: Unified environment resolution allows switching seamlessly between Direct Anthropic, GCP Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock deployments using ambient credentials and explicit flags.

criteria.action: expose Resolve(env Env) (*anthropic.Client, Source, error) where Env allows injecting variable lookups and override maps without modifying process-level environment variables
criteria.contract: Resolve accepts the Env interface without reading or mutating os.Environ; SourceDirect, SourceVertex, and SourceBedrock are distinct typed Source constants

setup: an Env lookup map implementation isolating process environment variables
check.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-ant-test"}; c, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceDirect

criteria.action: define Source as a typed string with values SourceDirect, SourceVertex, and SourceBedrock

criteria.condition: env evaluates CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX as truthy ("1" or "true") and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX is not an explicit off flag ("0" or "false")
criteria.action: construct an *anthropic.Client configured for Google Cloud Vertex AI using ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID (or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT), CLOUD_ML_REGION (defaulting to "global"), and custom proxy URL ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL if set, and return SourceVertex
criteria.contract: it returns SourceVertex; the resolved client is configured with Vertex authentication and the custom base URL

setup: an Env containing CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID=my-project, CLOUD_ML_REGION=europe-west1, and ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL=https://custom-proxy.internal
check.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX": "1", "ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID": "my-proj", "CLOUD_ML_REGION": "europe-west1", "ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL": "https://custom-proxy.internal"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceVertex; assert client != nil

criteria.condition: env evaluates CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK as truthy ("1" or "true") and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK is not an explicit off flag ("0" or "false")
criteria.action: construct an *anthropic.Client configured for AWS Bedrock and return SourceBedrock
criteria.contract: it returns SourceBedrock; the resolved client pointer is non-nil and configured for AWS Bedrock

setup: an Env containing CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=true
check.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK": "true"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceBedrock; assert client != nil

criteria.condition: neither Vertex nor Bedrock is enabled and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is present in env
criteria.action: construct a direct Anthropic client configured with the key or token and optional ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, and return SourceDirect
criteria.contract: it returns SourceDirect; the client is configured with the provided base URL and API key

setup: an Env containing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03 and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.anthropic.internal
check.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-ant-api03", "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "https://api.anthropic.internal"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceDirect; assert client != nil

criteria.condition: neither Vertex nor Bedrock is enabled and neither ANTHROPIC_API_KEY nor ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is present in env
criteria.action: reject the resolution and return an error explaining that credentials are missing
criteria.contract: non-nil error stating missing credentials and nil client pointer

setup: an Env with no Vertex or Bedrock flags and empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
check.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert client == nil; assert err != nil; assert strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "credentials")

criteria.condition: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX or CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK is explicitly set to "0" or "false" and secondary cloud project coordinates exist in env
criteria.action: disable the specified cloud deployment and fall through to direct resolution
criteria.contract: Vertex deployment is disabled despite the presence of project coordinates; it falls through to direct resolution returning SourceDirect

setup: an Env with CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=0, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=my-project, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-test
check.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX": "0", "GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT": "my-project", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-ant-test"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceDirect

criteria.action: verify Direct, Vertex, and Bedrock client configurations and base URLs offline without initiating network requests
criteria.contract: client options, URLs, and source targets are validated offline; zero HTTP network connections or outbound DNS resolutions are initiated

setup: synthetic Env maps for Direct, Vertex, and Bedrock configurations
check.pseudocode: for _, tc := range cases { c, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(tc.env); assert err == nil; assert tc.validateConfig(c, src) }

requirements.title: Claude Model Catalog and Lookup
requirements.rationale: Simplifying the catalog to Claude model lookups eliminates dead multi-vendor code while providing safe fallback descriptors for newly released models.

criteria.action: remove all non-Claude vendor sections (OpenAI, Google) from catalog/catalog.json and retain only Claude model descriptors
criteria.contract: catalog.json contains Claude model entries and zero OpenAI or Google model entries; neither catalog/resolve.go nor catalog/clamp.go exists in the repository

setup: the catalog package directory and catalog.json file
check.pseudocode: raw = read('catalog/catalog.json'); assert 'claude' in raw; assert 'gpt-' not in raw; assert 'gemini' not in raw; assert not fileExists('catalog/resolve.go'); assert not fileExists('catalog/clamp.go')

criteria.action: remove catalog/resolve.go and catalog/clamp.go

criteria.condition: catalog.Lookup(id string) is called with a known Claude model ID, with or without an "anthropic/" prefix
criteria.action: return the corresponding core.Model descriptor and boolean true
criteria.contract: it returns the corresponding core.Model descriptor; the returned boolean is true

setup: known Claude model IDs with and without the anthropic/ vendor prefix
check.pseudocode: m1, ok1 := catalog.Lookup("claude-sonnet-4-5"); assert ok1 == true; assert m1.ID == "claude-sonnet-4-5"; m2, ok2 := catalog.Lookup("anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5"); assert ok2 == true; assert m2.ID == "claude-sonnet-4-5"

criteria.condition: catalog.Lookup(id string) is called with an uncataloged model ID
criteria.action: return a default core.Model descriptor with ID set to the queried string, context window of 1,000,000 tokens, output cap of 128,000 tokens, ThinkingKindAdaptive, zero cost, and boolean false
criteria.contract: it returns a core.Model descriptor with ID set to claude-next-gen-future; ContextWindow is 1000000, MaxOutput is 128000, and ThinkingKind is ThinkingKindAdaptive; cost rates are zero; the returned boolean is false

setup: an unknown model ID such as claude-next-gen-future
check.pseudocode: m, ok := catalog.Lookup("claude-next-gen-future"); assert ok == false; assert m.ID == "claude-next-gen-future"; assert m.ContextWindow == 1000000; assert m.MaxOutput == 128000; assert m.Cost.InputUSDPer1M == 0; assert m.Cost.OutputUSDPer1M == 0

criteria.action: for any model ID queried against catalog.Lookup, return a usable model descriptor without rejecting the query with an error
criteria.contract: catalog.Lookup returns a usable model descriptor; the call does not panic, error, or return an empty descriptor ID

setup: a string generator producing arbitrary model identifier strings
check.pseudocode: for id in genModelIDs(): m, _ := catalog.Lookup(id); assert len(m.ID) > 0; assert m.ContextWindow > 0; assert m.MaxOutput > 0

criteria.action: isolate all model pricing rates, token limits, and thinking capabilities exclusively within catalog without hardcoding model identifiers or rates in provider/anthropic
criteria.contract: no hardcoded model identifiers, token limits, or price tables exist in provider/anthropic; model metadata is queried solely through the catalog package

setup: the provider/anthropic codebase
check.pseudocode: files = listFiles('provider/anthropic/*.go'); for f in files: assert not containsPricingOrHardcodedModelLimits(f)

requirements.title: Adaptive Thinking and Effort Controls
requirements.rationale: Modern Claude models require adaptive thinking with discrete effort levels and reject legacy budget tokens with 400 Bad Request errors.

criteria.action: define the Effort type with discrete levels EffortLow ("low"), EffortMedium ("medium"), EffortHigh ("high"), EffortXHigh ("xhigh"), and EffortMax ("max")
criteria.contract: core.EffortLow equals "low"; core.EffortMedium equals "medium"; core.EffortHigh equals "high"; core.EffortXHigh equals "xhigh"; core.EffortMax equals "max"

setup: package core
check.pseudocode: assert core.EffortLow == "low"; assert core.EffortMedium == "medium"; assert core.EffortHigh == "high"; assert core.EffortXHigh == "xhigh"; assert core.EffortMax == "max"

criteria.condition: encoding a request for a model configured with adaptive thinking and an effort level is specified
criteria.action: emit "thinking": {"type": "adaptive"} and "output_config": {"effort": "<level>"} and omit budget_tokens
criteria.contract: the JSON payload contains "thinking": {"type": "adaptive"}; the JSON payload contains "output_config": {"effort": "high"}; "budget_tokens" is omitted from the thinking object

setup: a request for a model with adaptive thinking configured with core.EffortHigh
check.pseudocode: req := core.Request{Model: "claude-sonnet-4-5", Effort: core.EffortHigh}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(req); assert wire["thinking"]["type"] == "adaptive"; assert wire["output_config"]["effort"] == "high"; assert "budget_tokens" not in wire["thinking"]

criteria.condition: encoding a request for a model configured with legacy budget thinking and a token budget is specified
criteria.action: emit budget_tokens and omit output_config.effort
criteria.contract: the JSON payload contains "thinking": {"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 4096}; "output_config" does not specify an effort level

setup: a request for a model configured with legacy budget thinking and a budget of 4096 tokens
check.pseudocode: req := core.Request{Model: "claude-legacy-3", ThinkingBudget: 4096}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(req); assert wire["thinking"]["budget_tokens"] == 4096; assert "effort" not in wire["output_config"]

criteria.condition: a model's catalog metadata does not support reasoning effort
criteria.action: omit the thinking parameter without mutating or clamping the request to off
criteria.contract: neither "thinking" nor "output_config.effort" is present in the serialized payload; the input request object remains unmodified

setup: a request targeting a model whose catalog entry indicates no reasoning effort support
check.pseudocode: req := core.Request{Model: "claude-no-thinking"}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(req); assert "thinking" not in wire; assert "output_config" not in wire

requirements.title: Strict Tool Serialization and Schema Projection
requirements.rationale: Emitting strict: true guarantees adherence to schema definitions, while stripping internal tool metadata and forbidding forced tool choices prevents wire rejections.

criteria.condition: emitting tool definitions on the Anthropic wire
criteria.action: set "strict": true on every tool declaration
criteria.contract: every tool object in the tools array contains "strict": true

setup: a tool list containing multiple tools
check.pseudocode: tools := []core.Tool{{Name: "search", InputSchema: schema1}, {Name: "edit", InputSchema: schema2}}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(core.Request{Tools: tools}); for t in wire["tools"]: assert t["strict"] == true

criteria.action: strip internal tool fields OutputSchema, ReachableTools, and Terminating from wire tool definitions
criteria.contract: none of OutputSchema, ReachableTools, or Terminating (or their snake_case variants) appear in the serialized tool definitions

setup: tools configured with OutputSchema, ReachableTools, and Terminating properties
check.pseudocode: t := core.Tool{Name: "test", OutputSchema: s, ReachableTools: []string{"sub"}, Terminating: true}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(core.Request{Tools: []core.Tool{t}}); toolJSON := toJSON(wire["tools"][0]); assert "OutputSchema" not in toolJSON; assert "output_schema" not in toolJSON; assert "ReachableTools" not in toolJSON; assert "terminating" not in toolJSON

criteria.condition: emitting tool choice options on the Anthropic wire
criteria.action: omit forced tool choice ("any" or a named tool lock) and set tool_choice to "auto" or omit the field
criteria.contract: no forced tool choice such as "any" or a named tool lock is emitted on the wire; tool_choice is either omitted or set to {"type": "auto"}

setup: requests configured with default, forced, or auto tool choices
check.pseudocode: wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(core.Request{ToolChoice: core.ToolChoiceAny}); assert wire["tool_choice"] == nil || wire["tool_choice"]["type"] == "auto"

requirements.title: Argument Byte Preservation and Prompt Cache Breakpoints
requirements.rationale: Preserving argument JSON bytes and establishing fixed prompt cache breakpoints maximizes prompt cache hit rates across iterative agent turns.

criteria.condition: replaying assistant tool_use argument inputs across multi-turn requests
criteria.action: preserve the exact raw bytes received from the model (json.RawMessage) without re-serializing or reformatting JSON keys
criteria.contract: the replayed tool_use input in the wire request matches the original raw argument bytes exactly without reformatting

setup: an assistant message with a tool_use block whose RawArguments contains specific spacing and key ordering
check.pseudocode: raw := json.RawMessage(`{"b": 1,  "a":  2}`); msg := core.AssistantMessage{Content: core.Content{core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "call_1", Name: "tool", RawArguments: raw}}}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(core.Request{Messages: []core.Message{msg}}); assert string(wire["messages"][0]["content"][0]["input"]) == string(raw)

criteria.condition: constructing request payloads with a system prompt
criteria.action: apply ephemeral cache control ("cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}) to the final content block of the system prompt
criteria.contract: cache_control with type ephemeral appears on the final system content block and nowhere else in system blocks; cache_control with type ephemeral appears on the final tool definition and nowhere else in tool definitions

setup: a request with multiple system content blocks and multiple tool definitions
check.pseudocode: wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(reqWithMultipleSystemAndTools); assert wire["system"][last]["cache_control"]["type"] == "ephemeral"; assert wire["system"][0]["cache_control"] == nil; assert wire["tools"][last]["cache_control"]["type"] == "ephemeral"; assert wire["tools"][0]["cache_control"] == nil

criteria.condition: constructing request payloads with tool definitions
criteria.action: apply ephemeral cache control ("cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}) to the final tool definition in the tools list

criteria.condition: prefix messages are provided in the conversation history
criteria.action: apply ephemeral cache control ("cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}) to the final content block of the prefix messages
criteria.contract: cache_control with type ephemeral is applied to the final content block of the prefix messages; cache_control with type ephemeral is applied to the final content block of the user message history

setup: a request containing prefix messages and user conversation history with multiple blocks
check.pseudocode: wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(reqWithPrefixAndUser); assert wire["messages"][prefixLastMsg]["content"][last]["cache_control"]["type"] == "ephemeral"; assert wire["messages"][userLastMsg]["content"][last]["cache_control"]["type"] == "ephemeral"

criteria.condition: constructing request payloads with user message history
criteria.action: apply ephemeral cache control ("cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}) to the final content block of the user message history

requirements.title: Response and Stream Translation
requirements.rationale: Translating official SDK responses into AgentKit core types ensures seamless integration with transcript history and accurate token cost accounting.

criteria.condition: receiving responses or streaming events from the Anthropic SDK
criteria.action: translate SDK message payloads into core.AssistantMessage with content blocks including TextBlock, ThinkingBlock, and ToolUseBlock
criteria.contract: it returns a core.AssistantMessage; content blocks are correctly mapped to core.TextBlock, core.ThinkingBlock, and core.ToolUseBlock

setup: an Anthropic SDK Message object containing text, thinking, and tool_use blocks
check.pseudocode: sdkMsg := makeSDKMessageWithTextThinkingTool(); coreMsg := anthropic.TranslateMessage(sdkMsg); assert len(coreMsg.Content) == 3; _, ok0 := coreMsg.Content[0].(core.ThinkingBlock); assert ok0; _, ok1 := coreMsg.Content[1].(core.TextBlock); assert ok1; _, ok2 := coreMsg.Content[2].(core.ToolUseBlock); assert ok2

criteria.condition: translating streaming events or message deltas from the Anthropic SDK
criteria.action: record token consumption in core.Usage, tracking input tokens, output tokens, cache read tokens, cache creation tokens, and increment request counts
criteria.contract: the resulting core.Usage records input tokens, output tokens, cache read tokens, and cache creation tokens; the total request count is incremented

setup: an Anthropic streaming event sequence containing message_start and message_delta with usage metadata
check.pseudocode: usage := anthropic.TranslateUsage(startUsage, deltaUsage); assert usage.InputTokens == 150; assert usage.OutputTokens == 42; assert usage.CacheReadTokens == 100; assert usage.CacheCreationTokens == 50; assert usage.Requests == 1

criteria.action: forward stream events to the agent event stream without blocking the provider loop when consumers process slowly
criteria.contract: the stream loop processes incoming events without deadlocking or blocking on the consumer channel buffer

setup: a provider stream connected to a subscriber channel that consumes events slowly
check.pseudocode: streamCh := make(chan core.StreamEvent, 1); go p.Stream(ctx, req, streamCh); time.Sleep(10*time.Millisecond); for ev := range streamCh { ... }

requirements.title: Wire Golden Request Verification
requirements.rationale: Golden request tests pin serialization invariants and guard against accidental drift across SDK updates.

criteria.condition: running golden_requests_test.go against testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
criteria.action: assert the complete wire request produced by the SDK encoder matches the golden request fixture
criteria.contract: the serialized HTTP request body produced by the SDK encoder matches request_anthropic.json exactly

setup: the canonical test request and testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
check.pseudocode: goldenBytes := read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json'); reqBytes := anthropic.EncodeCanonical(canonicalRequest(t)); assert bytes.Equal(reqBytes, goldenBytes)

criteria.action: assert that cache_control appears exactly on the last system block, last tool definition, last prefix block, and last user block
criteria.contract: cache_control appears on the final system block; cache_control appears on the final tool definition; cache_control appears on the final prefix block; cache_control appears on the final user block; no other blocks contain cache_control

setup: the serialized golden request payload in testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
check.pseudocode: payload := parseJSON(read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json')); assertPayloadCacheControlPositions(payload)

criteria.action: assert that every tool carries "strict": true and that no OutputSchema, ReachableTools, or Terminating fields appear in the payload
criteria.contract: every tool definition contains strict: true; none of OutputSchema, reachable_tools, terminating, or their camelCase variants appear anywhere in the payload

setup: the serialized golden request payload in testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
check.pseudocode: raw := read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json'); assert '"strict":true' in raw; assert 'OutputSchema' not in raw; assert 'reachable_tools' not in raw; assert 'terminating' not in raw

criteria.action: assert that modern models emit "thinking": {"type": "adaptive"} and "output_config": {"effort": "<level>"} without budget_tokens
criteria.contract: "thinking" has type "adaptive"; "output_config" contains "effort"; "budget_tokens" does not appear anywhere in the payload

setup: the serialized golden request payload in testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
check.pseudocode: payload := parseJSON(read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json')); assert payload.Thinking.Type == "adaptive"; assert len(payload.OutputConfig.Effort) > 0; assert 'budget_tokens' not in read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json')

criteria.action: assert that replayed tool_use arguments match the input fixture byte-for-byte
criteria.contract: the argument bytes in the tool_use blocks match the input JSON bytes byte-for-byte without key reordering or whitespace alterations

setup: the serialized golden request payload in testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
check.pseudocode: payload := parseJSON(read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json')); assert payload.Messages[assistantIdx].Content[toolUseIdx].InputRaw == canonicalToolUseInputRaw

execution_paths.title: Offline environment resolution for Claude on Google Cloud Vertex AI

steps.action: injects environment variables CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID=test-project, and CLOUD_ML_REGION=us-central1 via Env
evaluates anthropic.Resolve(env) and identifies Vertex AI deployment configuration
constructs an *anthropic.Client configured with Vertex Google authentication and regional base URL
inspects the resolved client and asserts SourceVertex without making external network calls

setup: an Env configured with CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID=test-project, and CLOUD_ML_REGION=us-central1
end_state: it resolves SourceVertex with an *anthropic.Client configured for Google Cloud Vertex AI
resolution completes offline without network requests
smoke.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX": "1", "ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID": "test-project", "CLOUD_ML_REGION": "us-central1"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; if src != anthropic.SourceVertex { t.Fatalf("want SourceVertex, got %v", src) }; if client == nil { t.Fatal("expected non-nil client") }

execution_paths.title: Wire request encoding with strict tools, adaptive thinking, and prompt caching

steps.action: prepares a canonical request with system prompt, user history, a tool definition, and EffortHigh
evaluates catalog.Lookup to obtain model metadata confirming adaptive thinking capabilities
builds the Anthropic Messages wire request adding strict: true, ephemeral cache control breakpoints, and adaptive thinking effort
verifies the serialized request matches testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json byte-for-byte

setup: a canonical agent request configured with system prompt, user message, tool definition, and EffortHigh against a known Claude model
end_state: the resulting JSON payload matches testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json byte-for-byte
strict tools, adaptive thinking effort, and ephemeral prompt cache breakpoints are serialized exactly
smoke.pseudocode: req := canonicalRequest(t); model, ok := catalog.Lookup(req.Model); if !ok { t.Fatal("model not found") }; body, err := anthropic.BuildRequestJSON(req, model); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; golden, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json"); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; if !bytes.Equal(body, golden) { t.Fatalf("golden mismatch:\n%s", diff(golden, body)) }

execution_paths.title: Multi-turn assistant tool use replay with raw byte preservation

steps.action: streams an assistant message containing a tool_use block with formatted JSON input
extracts the raw JSON argument bytes into core.AssistantMessage without deserialization
submits the conversation history containing the assistant message to anthropic.BuildRequest for the next turn
serializes the replayed tool_use block retaining the exact original JSON bytes on the wire

setup: an incoming assistant stream chunk with raw tool_use argument JSON bytes
end_state: the raw argument bytes in the outgoing wire request match the incoming argument bytes byte-for-byte
smoke.pseudocode: raw := []byte(`{"path": "foo/bar.go",   "query": "func Test"}`); asstMsg := anthropic.TranslateAssistantEvent(raw); req := core.Request{Messages: []core.Message{asstMsg, core.ToolResultMessage{ToolUseID: "call_1", Content: core.Content{core.TextBlock{Text: "ok"}}}}}; out := anthropic.BuildRequestJSON(req, defaultModel); assertReplayedToolUseBytesEqual(out, raw)
